title: Padded action commutes with configuration embedding
statement: Let $m	ext{ and }k$ be natural numbers with $m\le k$, let $B$ and $SS$ be types, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input string. For any injection $SS\to B$, any action on $m$ work tapes with symbols in $�$ and states in $SS$, any configuration for that machine, and any $b\in B$, applying the action padded to $k$ tapes (with its state mapped by the injection) to the embedded configuration whose state is set to $b$ gives the embedding of the result of applying the original action to the original configuration.
